text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity here. The environment is modern and vibrant, characterized by glass walls, striking colors, and digital screens. The "R + D" signage on the display wall signals a space dedicated to research and development—where ideas are explored and new concepts are born. I feel inspired, as if invited to engage with innovation and creativity. Simultaneously, the cleanliness and organization evoke a slight detachment, reminding me of the boundaries between people, ideas, and the physical structures that house them.
